ideas.title: Cabbage and Carrot Slaw with Avocado
ideas.blurb: This refreshing slaw uses up the red cabbage and carrots, topped with creamy avocado.

recipe.description: A crunchy slaw of shredded red cabbage and grated carrot, sharpened with lime and topped with sliced avocado. No cooking, and ready in the time it takes to shred the cabbage.
steps: Finely shred the red cabbage and put it in a large bowl.
Grate the carrots and add them to the cabbage.
Whisk the lime or lemon juice with the olive oil, salt and pepper.
Pour the dressing over the cabbage and carrots and toss well. Leave for 5 minutes to soften.
Halve, stone and slice the avocado. Lay it on top just before serving.

ideas.title: Vegetable Stir-Fry
ideas.blurb: A quick stir-fry that highlights your fresh veggies like broccoli, bell pepper, and spinach.

recipe.description: This Vegetable Stir-Fry showcases fresh broccoli, green bell pepper, and spinach for a quick and healthy meal. It's a vibrant dish packed with nutrients and flavors, perfect for a busy weeknight dinner.
steps: Wash and chop the broccoli into small florets.
Slice the green bell pepper into thin strips.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large pan or wok over medium-high heat (about 2 minutes).
Add the broccoli florets and green bell pepper strips to the pan and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until they start to soften.
Add the grated ginger and stir for another minute until fragrant.
Add the spinach and soy sauce, and stir-fry for an additional 2-3 minutes until the spinach wilts.
Season with salt and pepper to taste before serving.

ideas.title: Stuffed Cucumber Boats
ideas.blurb: Cucumber boats filled with a mix of tomato, radish, and herbs make a light and crunchy dinner.

recipe.description: Cucumber halves hollowed out and filled with a creamy mix of diced tomato, radish and herbs. Light, crunchy and needs no cooking.
ingredients: A small handful of fresh herbs, chopped
steps: Halve the cucumber lengthways and scoop out the seeds with a teaspoon to make two boats.
Pat the inside of each boat dry with kitchen paper and season lightly with salt.
Finely dice the tomato and radishes, and chop the herbs.
Mix the tomato, radish and most of the herbs into the cream cheese or hummus. Season with salt and pepper.
Spoon the filling into the cucumber boats.
Scatter over the remaining herbs, cut each boat into three pieces and serve.

ideas.title: Roasted Vegetable Medley
ideas.blurb: A hearty medley of roasted carrots, broccoli, and bell pepper, perfect for a comforting dinner.

recipe.description: Carrots, broccoli and green pepper roasted until the edges catch and the carrots turn sweet. One tray, and the oven does the work.
ingredients: 1 small piece of broccoli, cut into florets
1/2 green bell pepper, cut into chunks
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan).
Cut the carrots into batons, the broccoli into florets and the pepper into chunks.
Toss the carrots with half the olive oil, salt and pepper on a large baking tray. Roast for 10 minutes.
Add the broccoli and pepper with the rest of the oil and toss everything together.
Roast for another 12-15 minutes, until the carrots are tender and the broccoli is browned at the edges.
Taste, season again if needed, and serve hot.

ideas.title: Spinach and Tomato Salad
ideas.blurb: A simple salad that combines fresh spinach with tomato, cucumber, and a light dressing.

recipe.description: Fresh spinach with tomato, cucumber and crumbled feta in a simple oil and vinegar dressing. On the table in ten minutes.
steps: Wash the spinach, dry it well and put it in a large bowl.
Cut the tomato into wedges and slice the cucumber. Add both to the bowl.
Whisk the olive oil with the vinegar or lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently.
Crumble the feta over the top and serve straight away.
